whatItDoes.title: HydroTrail sets your water by the trail
intro: Day-hikers plan to sip every 20 minutes. Then the heat and the climbs break the plan.
Apple Health, Garmin and kitchen water apps remind you on a wall clock. They don't know you just climbed 550 m (1,800 ft) in the heat.
HydroTrail starts from your weight and the packets you carry, then adjusts for heat, altitude and pace.

outputs.title: A sip target
outputs.body: Millilitres per hour, updated as the heat, the climb and your pace change.

outputs.title: A next-packet time
outputs.body: When to take your next electrolyte or carb packet.

outputs.title: A “Took a sip” button
outputs.body: One tap logs it, with your other hand still on a pole.

whatItDoes.rulesIntro: The rules are plain TypeScript, with no AI call on each step.
whatItDoes.rulesEnding: At the cap it tells you to slow down and find shade.

screens.title: The four screens, in the order I build them
screens.intro: The landing screen is the one I promise to get working. Setup and the live hike come next. The recap comes last, if time holds.
screens.closing: Built with Claude Code on Next.js, Tailwind and shadcn. Data stays on the device for now. Supabase sign-in is the next step, and you can add it yourself afterwards.

value.question: Is it really free?
value.answer: Yes. Watching is free, and so is registering, which gets you the replay for {replayDays} days.

value.question: Do I need to code?
value.answer: No. We use AI tools and copy-paste prompts. Knowing some code helps, but you don't need it to follow along or to get a first screen working.

value.question: What tools will you use, and do they cost anything?
value.answer: We'll use {tools}. You don't need to install anything to watch. If you want to try Prompt 1 afterwards, a free account on one of these is enough to start.

value.question: Do I have to register to watch?
value.answer: No. It's on YouTube Live, the link is public, and it'll be on this page when we start. Register on Luma if you want a reminder and the replay.

value.question: I can't make it live. Is there a replay?
value.answer: Yes, for registrants. You'll get the replay link by email, and it stays up for {replayDays} days. After that, an edited version goes up publicly on YouTube.

value.question: What time is it for me?
value.answer: {timeZoneSummary} The line under the register button shows your own time.

value.question: Will you email me?
value.answer: Yes: a confirmation, reminders before the session, the replay link afterwards, and the Weekend MVP newsletter. You can unsubscribe at any time. Questions? Email {supportEmail}.

value.question: Do I need an idea already?
value.answer: No. If you don't have one, you'll leave knowing how to pick one from the library.
